claim.title: Balancer Pools weights are dynamic However this is not considered in the Balancerconnector leading to incorrect evaluation of a pool's TVL whenever the weights are changed.

claim.plausibility_narrative: Keepers::execute function should hash nine rlp encoded elements instead of only six v of the signature is not set currectly As it's written in EIP712 standard: "v parameter includes the chain id as specified in EIP-155." The v parameter includes chainId in calculations so it's a must to encode 9 elements in order to get the valid v value. "If block.number = FORKBLKNUM and CHAINID is available, then when computing the hash of a transaction for the purposes of signing, instead of hashing only six rlp encoded elements (nonce, gasprice, startgas, to, value, data), you SHOULD hash nine rlp encoded elements(nonce, gasprice, startgas, to, value, data, chainid, 0, 0). If you do, then the v of the signature MUST be set to {0,1} + CHAINID 2 + 35 where {0,1} is the parity of the y value of the curve
claim.title: `Keepers::execute` function should hash nine rlp encoded elements instead of only six
